description:
Pokemon HeartGold & SoulSilver -- registered game name "Pokemon
HGSS Singe" (renamed 2026-08-15 from "Pokemon HeartGold" now that both
versions are equally first-class, see docs/architecture.md's
"SoulSilver support" entry; renamed again for v0.2.5 because another
HGSS apworld already registers "Pokemon HGSS", and Archipelago refuses
two worlds with the same game name).

# Pokemon HGSS Singe APWorld   v0.2.5

**Breaking release**  Seeds generated with v0.2.4 or earlier cannot be played with this version: finish them with the v0.2.4-hotfix apworld.

## Files

- `poke_hgss.apworld`: the world. Put it in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder.
- `Poke_HGSS.yaml`: the default options file, ready to edit.
- `poke_hgss_tracker.html`: web tracker, open it in your browser (double-click).

## How to update

1. Remove `pokemon_hgss.apworld` from `custom_worlds` and add `poke_hgss.apworld`. The world was renamed, so it can now sit next to the other HGSS world.
2. Update your YAML: the `game:` line and the options section header become `Pokemon HGSS Singe` (or start from `Poke_HGSS.yaml`).
3. Generate a new seed. Patch files now end in `.appokehgss`.

## Highlights

- **No more slot name to type.** The patched ROM carries your slot, and the BizHawk Client logs in on its own. You still enter the server address once per session (the client reminds you if you forget).
- **Global Exp. Share** (`global_exp_share`) and an **Exp. multiplier** (`exp_multiplier`, 10 to 1000 %).
- **Headbutt trees are randomized** with `randomize_wild_pokemon`, and count for Dexsanity (`dexsanity_encounter_types: headbutt`).
- **Web tracker**: a Pokegear-style map where towns, routes and caves turn green, orange or red by what you can reach, lists by region that fold out down to each check, a "?" that shows what a check holds (without hints), goal, key items, badges, gym leaders beaten and HMs at the top. French or English. Same logic as the world.
- **PopTracker pack**, in French or English, with autotracking and the world's own logic.
- **The Bell Tower and Whirl Islands monks** let you through with the wing in your Bag, wherever it came from.
- New client commands: `/pending` (items sent to you that are not in your game yet) and `/restore_power`.

## Fixes

- Audit of all 92 NPC gifts: gifts that are only handed out after an event (S.S. Ticket, Squirtbottle, SecretPotion, Exp. Share, TM59, the Bells, HM02, HM08, PP Max, GB Sounds) are no longer expected too early, and four post-game or missable gifts can no longer hold progression items.
- Bag items could stop arriving while badges still did: the client now finds your save data again on its own, and tells you when a pocket is full.
- Viridian Gym and Cerulean Cave now follow the Kanto Leaders you really beat, not badge items.
- Route 12 and Route 14 logic corrected.
v0.2.5.title: v0.2.5

v0.2.5r6.description:
# Pokemon HGSS Singe APWorld - v0.2.5 Hotfix

Bug-fix release on top of v0.2.5, built from player reports. **Compatible with games already in progress**: the world version is still 0.10.0, so no new generation is needed.

## Files

- `poke_hgss.apworld`: the world. Replace the old one in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder.
- `poke_hgss_tracker.html`: web tracker, open it in your browser (double-click).

## How to update

1. Replace `poke_hgss.apworld` in `custom_worlds` with the one attached below.

2. Open your existing `.appokehgss` again: it builds a new `.nds` for the same seed, with the same name, so BizHawk keeps your save.
- **Client fixes** work as soon as the apworld is replaced.
- **ROM fixes** need step 2 (re-patch the same seed).
- **Logic fixes** only change newly generated seeds.

## Fixes for games in progress

### Client (just replace the apworld)

- **Items received during a battle were lost** (Expert Belt, Apricorn Box...). A battle copies the Bag and writes it back when it ends, wiping anything delivered meanwhile. The client now waits for the battle to end, and delivers again anything a long battle still wiped.

- **Items received but missing after a reload** (Squirtbottle, Basement Key...). The count of delivered items now lives in the save itself. Key items and HMs already lost are given back.

- **New command `/resend <item>`**: one more copy of an item the server really sent you, for anything lost with an older client.

- **"Bag data looks wrong, searching for your save data again." every second, and no item arriving any more.** An odd Bag entry made the client drop its save address forever. It now trusts the save's Pokedex signature, reports the odd entry once, and keeps delivering.

- **Secret Potion in the Bag, but Jasmine ignores it.** Receiving it now also sets what the lighthouse checks, and sends the Cianwood pharmacy check.

- **Stuck at the top of the Olivine Lighthouse** after Jasmine left (see the ROM fix below). On any ROM, once you own the Secret Potion, the client opens the way out: if you are already stuck, save and reload.

- **Clear Bell / Tidal Bell**: the Kimono Girls give only one of them; getting it now sends both checks.

- **TM78 "Game Corner JP"** is sent when you walk into the Goldenrod Game Corner (that ball stands in an area the US games never reach).

- **Checks that can be missed for good are sent for you**: the Basement Key, Card Key and takeover trainers once Archer is beaten; the Flower Shop Squirtbottle once the Sudowoodo is gone; trainers the story hides for good (Mahogany hideout, Lighthouse 4F, Slowpoke Well, Lake of Rage's Alton).

- **Story chains an out-of-order run could break** (the Radio Tower takeover counter, the Kimono Girls' bell chain) are repaired by the client.

### ROM (open your .appokehgss again)
- **DeathLink did nothing.** A death is now the game's own whiteout, both ways: whiting out sends one, and a received one whites you out on your next step (never during a battle or a Safari Game). On an older ROM, the client tells you to re-patch.

- **Stuck at the top of the Olivine Lighthouse**: Jasmine's first talk, the only one that opens the way out, was skipped when you already had the Secret Potion. It now always comes first.

- **Randomized trainers kept their old Pokemon's moves** (Bugsy's Koffing with Scyther's U-turn). Gym Leaders and the other trainers with hand-picked moves now give a replaced Pokemon the moves it knows at its level.

- **Seven gifts never reported their check** (catching tutorial, Elm's Potion, Mystery Egg, VS Recorder, HM04, Jade Orb, S.S. Aqua Metal Coat).

- **Leaders fightable again and gifts handed out twice after a day change.**

- **Mom no longer stops you on New Bark's east shore** between Clair's badge and the box-art legendary.

- **Umbreon and Espeon** can be obtained again with `convert_trade_evolutions`.

### Patching
- **"File hash does not match" with a US ROM**: trimmed US dumps are accepted, and a wrong ROM is named in the error with what to do (Archipelago keeps a copy of the first ROM it was given: delete it, then patch again).

## Logic (new seeds)

Every map was walked on both ROMs' own collision data and every story lock checked against the game's scripts. Among the fixes:
- **The Sudowoodo**: the tree on Route 36 is a three-way fork, and each side needs the Squirtbottle (Route 37 and Ecruteak were in logic from Goldenrod without it).
- **Places the logic thought reachable but the game does not let you reach**: Tohjo Falls, Mt. Mortar, Cerulean Cave, Victory Road, Slowpoke Well, Dark Cave, Whirl Islands, Ruins of Alph, Union Cave, Seafoam Islands, Mt. Silver and many routes now ask for exactly the field moves each spot needs.
- **Story locks**: Route 30 before the Mystery Egg, Goldenrod and Ecruteak gyms, the Radio Tower takeover (Archer needs Morty, Chuck, Jasmine and Pryce beaten), Mahogany's east exit, Snorlax, the Power Plant, Misty, HM01 after Proton, Lugia's room, the Elite Four corridor, and more.
- **Dexsanity**: every wild table checked against the tiles it is rolled on; trackers now show each species as in logic only where this seed can really catch it.
- `johto_only` never leaves anything out of reach, and `johto_only` with `champion_red` is refused with a clear message.
- `sphere_based_trainer_leveling_bonus` is now added to every Pokemon.

## New

- **Options** `require_flash`, `trainersanity_count`, `dexsanity_count`.
- **Web tracker**: map redrawn after the game's Town Map, detailed New Bark plan, in-game icons, Gym Leaders tickable by hand.
- **Hint groups**: `HMs`, `Field Moves`, `Johto Badges`, `Kanto Badges`, `Badges`, `Wings`, one per field move.

## Workarounds for games in progress

- **A logic loop on a v0.2.5 seed** (an item behind the field move it unlocks): ask the host for the missing item (`/send` or `!getitem`). Logic fixes only reach new seeds.

v0.2.6.description:
# Pokemon HGSS Singe APWorld  v0.2.6

**New seeds needed** (APWorld version 0.2.6). A seed generated with v0.2.5 keeps working with the v0.2.5 apworld: finish it with that one, and generate new seeds with this one. The BizHawk Client warns you when a seed and the installed apworld do not match.

## Files

- `poke_hgss.apworld`: the world. Put it in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder.
- `Poke_HGSS.yaml`: the default options file, ready to edit.
- `poke_hgss_tracker.html`: web tracker, open it in your browser (double-click).

## How to update

1. Delete the old `poke_hgss.apworld` from `custom_worlds`, then add this one (the Launcher's "Install APWorld" does not overwrite an existing file).
2. Your YAML keeps working. The new options below are all off by default.
3. Generate a new seed.

## Highlights

- **Logic overhaul.** Every map was walked on the ROM's own collision data (HeartGold and SoulSilver, identical results) and every story lock was checked against the game's scripts: caves, cut trees, boulders, water and story events now ask for exactly what the game needs.
- **Items no longer lost**: the count of delivered items now lives in the save, so a reload, a game closed without saving or a battle running when an item arrives no longer loses it.
- **Weekday and night events are permanent**, so a check never depends on the day or the hour.
- **New quality of life options**, off by default:
  - `running_shoes_at_start` and `map_card_at_start`: the Cherrygrove Guide Gent's gifts from the start, useful with a random start;
  - `fly_points_at_start`: every Johto town is a Fly destination (not part of the logic);
  - `item_received_messages`: "Received X from Bob" on the BizHawk screen.
- **Web tracker** redrawn after the game's own Town Map, with in-game icons and Gym Leaders you can tick by hand.

## Fixes

- Player reports: Clear Bell and Tidal Bell, TM78 "Game Corner JP", items missing from the save, items lost during a battle, the "Bag data looks wrong" message, Jasmine ignoring the Secret Potion, "File hash does not match" with a trimmed US ROM, DeathLink, the Olivine Lighthouse, the Sudowoodo and the Squirtbottle, randomized trainers keeping their old moves.
- Radio Tower takeover, Mom at New Bark Town's east shore, `johto_only`, Dexsanity tables, badges found on the ground, Blackthorn Gym's TM59, Super Rod, Coin Case and Basement Key.
- Logic loosened where the map allows it: Ice Path B2F and B3F, Monica on Route 40.
- Olivine Gym's TM23 and the Department Store B1F Amulet Coin now ask for what the game really needs; the MooMoo Farm checks show as conditional in the trackers.
- Patching is about 50 s faster.

Full details in `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Use of an LLM

This project is developed with the help of an LLM. Every change is reviewed, the main files are read, and fixes are tested in game on HeartGold and SoulSilver before release. Details in the README.

Thanks You all for your FeedBack !!!! 

## Next time 

- `Shop_sanity` : shop will can containt somes Item from Archipelago
- Upgrade of `Randomizer_chart_sanity` -> APCheck for each Weakness\Efficiency detecte


Have nice day !!!
